line: Your Instagram views might be wrong right now, and you'd never know.
Picture one box. Instagram writes a number into it.
A second later, TikTok writes its own number into that exact same box.
TikTok's number erases Instagram's. Completely gone.
No warning. No error. It just looks like a normal number.
You have no way to know it's the wrong one.
This happens with Instagram and TikTok. It happens with Reels and Shorts too.
The fix is simple. Give each one its own box. Never let them share.
If a number ever looks wrong and you don't know why — this is the first thing to check.
